kind: Corrected local data-only CWD and resulting actual status; original tool result preserved
cmd:
set -e
sha256sum --check --status ../../collected-artifacts-relative.sha256
sha256sum --check --status snapshot.sha256
find . -type f -print0 | LC_ALL=C sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > ../../PAYLOAD-SHA256SUMS
sha256sum --check --status ../../PAYLOAD-SHA256SUMS
wc -l ../../PAYLOAD-SHA256SUMS snapshot.sha256
sha256sum snapshot.sha256 ready.nul prepared.json
